vertebrae.extractors.precomputed
================================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.precomputed

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Extractor for precomputed embeddings.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.precomputed.PrecomputedExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: PrecomputedExtractor(name = 'precomputed')

   Extractor for already-computed dense or sparse embeddings.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for precomputed embeddings.

      :param X: Embedding matrix.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: This extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Validate and return precomputed embeddings.

      :param X: Dense or sparse embedding matrix.

      :returns: Validated dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Return validated precomputed embeddings.

      :param X: Dense or sparse embedding matrix.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Validated dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable recipe for this extractor.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe dictionary.
